notes_for_editor: Four pages agree on a tower with an L-4 cab and its 1955 destruction; the Forest Service list dates the build to 1934 +/- and Forest Lookouts to c.1934. No staffing, fire or remains history appears in the sources read, so the story leaves those out. Access is undocumented beyond the hike-in label. The brief's county 'Idaho' is the state name; Firelookout.com's search snippet gives Idaho County, Idaho, but that text was not read on the page and is not quoted. Our grep of the FFLOS Idaho index (firetower.org) found none of the three names.
